title: gh-satd-miner: resilient multi-artifact mining for GitHub repositories
description: gh-satd-miner is a resilient mining pipeline for empirical software-engineering studies of self-admitted technical debt in GitHub repositories. It retrieves lexicon matches from code comments, commit messages, issue bodies, and pull-request bodies. The pipeline provides token rotation, batched GitHub Search API queries, incremental checkpoints, recovery from transient failures, and repository name canonicalization. It accompanies UBWSet, a dataset of ugly-but-it-works admissions in code comments.
